milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is 'find chest' — a locate/observe task where the player must navigate near the chest and face it. The chest is placed at spawn-relative (4, 0, -3) in the northeast corner of the stone brick room. max_distance=5 ensures the player has walked toward the chest corner (not just standing at spawn center ~5.8 blocks away), and facing_tolerance=60° ensures they are looking at it, confirming visual discovery.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a ladder results in ladder items appearing in the player's inventory. The ladder recipe consumes 7 sticks and produces 3 ladders. The player starts with an empty inventory (no ladders), so any ladder in inventory confirms successful crafting. min_count=1 is sufficient.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden hoe results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The recipe consumes 2 oak planks + 2 sticks and produces 1 wooden hoe. The player starts with an empty inventory (no wooden hoe), so any wooden_hoe in inventory confirms successful crafting.
